items.brief: Standard Chartered moves $2 trillion stablecoin forecast from 2028 to 2030 as supply growth stalls
items.why: Stablecoins are core settlement infrastructure for tokenized markets.

items.brief: BNY and Citadel Securities complete first tokenized Treasury repo on major triparty platform
items.why: Signals tokenized assets entering mainstream triparty repo infrastructure.

items.brief: DriveWealth to use Ripple's RLUSD for stablecoin settlement and cross-border payments
items.why: Stablecoin settlement adoption expands tokenized payment rails in Europe.

items.brief: Polygon Labs completes Coinme acquisition, adding 37 state money transmitter licenses
items.why: Expands regulated payment coverage for stablecoin payments infrastructure.

items.brief: Proposed 31.4% French tax on regulated stablecoins could push traders offshore
items.why: Tax burden on regulated stablecoins may hinder compliant tokenized settlement.

items.brief: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain happens outside US market hours
items.why: Round-the-clock tokenized equity trading shows demand beyond Wall Street hours.

items.brief: DRW and Marex complete OTC swap referencing tokenized S&P iBoxx Index
items.why: First OTC swap on a fully tokenized index shows derivative use of tokenized assets.
